jobs.description:
Deloitte offers leading audit and consulting services in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting, and Advisory – for nearly 90% of the Fortune Global 500® and numerous private companies. We deliver innovative thinking, solve complex challenges, and promote sustainable growth. With around 470,000 employees worldwide, we offer outstanding career opportunities – driven by a strong sense of “we” and a diversity of perspectives and skills.
The AI Experience Center (“AIXC”) is a highly innovative venue located in Düsseldorf, aimed at providing tangible interactive experiences to Deloitte's clients and practitioners by demonstrating AI’s potential for business and showcasing Deloitte’s own AI solutions & capabilities. The state-of-the-art space is equipped with cutting-edge AI software and hardware and is the latest addition to Deloitte’s portfolio of experience spaces in Düsseldorf (complementing the existing spaces of Deloitte Greenhouse & the Smart Factory) Secure our shared success and make a difference with us as: Head of AI Experience Center (m/f/d).

Standort: Düsseldorf.

Your impact:

As Head of the AI Experience Center (m/f/d), you serve as its ambassador and lead its strategy, operations, and market positioning. You drive client engagement, oversee daily management, and ensure the Center’s long-term growth and commercial success.

- Ownership & Leadership: You are the face of the space and take full end-to-end responsibility for the AIXC, ensuring its success as a leading AI innovation and experience hub
- Vision & Positioning: You shape the strategic direction, oversee the design and delivery of workshops and lab offerings (in collaboration with Deloitte Greenhouse), and narrative of the AI Experience Center
- AI Content & Assets Pipeline: You stay at the forefront of external AI market developments and continuously connect with AI innovators & specialists to onboard new AI assets to the space and design new formats & journeys
- Brand & Communication: You represent the AI Experience Center internally & externally, through targeted communication, events, and marketing initiatives. Furthermore, build & maintain a networks & key relationships that will enable success
- Business Enablement & Market Impact: You drive the adoption and utilization of the Center across client engagements, helping Deloitte teams showcase AI capabilities, create client value, and unlock new business opportunities

Your skillset:

- experienced leader (min. 8+ years of professional and leadership experience with a successful track record in business development & commercial ownership, ideally across industries & functions, or in a consulting environment
- excellent communication & stakeholder management skills and feel confident working with our diverse participant groups (from colleagues to startup founders to DAX board members)
- strong business and/or technical understanding of AI, emerging technologies, and/or digital transformation, and are able to connect client- and industry-specific challenges with AI technologies
- hands-on mentality with a structured mindset and want to work in and build a great team and contribute your skills
- excellent German and English skills, additional languages are a plus

Your chance:

- Best-in-class ongoing education at Deloitte University and through individual qualification programs and training sessions
- Extensive professional development opportunities with structured career planning, inclusive leadership, secondment programs, project-based job rotation, and support for societal engagement and corporate volunteering
- Work-family balance with a family advice service, mobile working, part-time hours, sabbaticals, support for family caregivers, counseling for parental leave, and much more
- A focus on health and fitness with regular health-themed days, partnerships with fitness providers, and support for sporting and team events
- Attractive employer benefits including bicycle and car leasing, a company smartphone for private use, and flexible working models (such as trust-based working hours and EU remote working)
- Plenty of scope for creativity and active promotion of an inclusive corporate culture – for instance through our diversity and inclusion employee networks

Are you ready? Make a difference with us!

Our recruiting team looks forward to receiving your application documents (CV as well as general qualification for university entrance, university and work references) via our online form. A cover letter and an application photo are not required.

Your contact for career-related questions

Our Talent Acquisition team – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja, and their teams – are happy to support you with any questions regarding your career at Deloitte. You can reach us via email at career@deloitte.de or by phone at +49 211 87724111.

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY

At Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.
The Position
The Study Physician role is a critical position within Clinical Development Inflammation, providing readily available, high-quality medical support and consultancy for global clinical trials. As a qualified and clinically experienced physician, you will contribute to the discovery, development and delivery of innovative medicines for patients and customers while helping to ensure scientific and medical quality throughout trial planning and conduct. In our international environment, you will collaborate with global colleagues and contribute directly to the success of Boehringer Ingelheim.
Tasks & responsibilities

- One of your key responsibilities will be to own the medical content of Clinical Trial Protocols and updates in line with the Trial Design Outline, working with the CTL, CPL, Patient Safety Physician, Medical Writer and other trial and evidence team members to ensure high medical quality and timely delivery of core trial documents and milestones.
- In regard to risk-based quality management, you will define medically relevant critical data and processes, assess associated risks, and establish mitigation and monitoring strategies in the Integrated Quality and Risk Management Plan. As medical co-author of the Clinical Quality Monitoring Plan, you will execute agile and adaptive monitoring using aggregated and near real-time data, proactively address quality issues, and ensure timely mitigation and escalation.
- Moreover, you will provide medical input into Data Management documentation, including eCRF design, CRF completion guidance, the Data Review Plan, automated and manual data checks, laboratory parameter specifications, Data Transfer Agreements and central laboratory alerts. You will also support the definition, review and assessment of important protocol deviations.
- Furthermore, you will be accountable for the medical content of patient information and informed consent materials, the Trial Level Monitoring Manual, Trial Communication Plan, Trial Training Plan and Trial Statistical Analysis Plan. You will contribute to patient narratives, Clinical Trial Report planning and review, regulatory and Ethics Committee or IRB responses, trial newsletters, and scientific publications where applicable.
- In addition, you will provide medical input into study and site feasibility, patient recruitment and retention plans, respond to medical queries from investigators, CROs and sponsor representatives, maintain the trial FAQ, build networks with experts, contribute to site engagement, and deliver medical training during country feasibility activities, investigator meetings and sponsor trainings.
- You will support Endpoint Adjudication, Data Monitoring Committees, Data Safety Monitoring Boards and Steering Committees, as applicable, by presenting the study's medical content, answering medical questions and helping to ensure high-quality data from a clinical quality monitoring perspective.

Requirements

- Physician (MD), ideally with a medical thesis, trained in a clinical setting and with a minimum of four years of active clinical practice; specialization in Pulmonology, Immunology, Internal Medicine, Infectious Diseases, Family Medicine, Pediatrics, Rheumatology or Emergency Medicine is desirable
- Experience in the pharmaceutical industry or a CRO in medical or project management functions, ideally in Clinical Development; specific experience in Inflammation Clinical Development is preferred
- Ability to communicate directly and concisely and to collaborate effectively with key stakeholders in an international environment
- Pronounced analytical skills combined with a systematic, well-structured and proactive working style and strong team spirit
- Pronounced presentation and training skills as well as excellent interpersonal, active listening and influencing skills
- Ability to use digital technologies to access information, communicate, navigate and learn, and to apply creativity and innovation when solving problems; fluency in written and spoken English

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until 09.10.2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to 02.10.2026 are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from end of September
Step 3: On-site interviews mid of October

Unternehmen

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy – a major step towards a climate-neutrality.
www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Aufgaben

You will be part of our global Automation organization and play a key role in the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of automation standards for electrolysis projects, including green hydrogen (AWE), chlor-alkali and HCl electrolysis technologies.
Your role involves assuming responsibility for defined engineering work packages to support parallel project execution and enhance delivery reliability and throughput as well as responsibility for complete automation scopes during various phases of project execution.
Your tasks:

- Acting as a technical lead for automation topics within projects executed by our global automation team
- Performing basic and detail engineering for control and safety systems, including architecture design, hardware planning and software concepts
- Supporting technical procurement, supplier clarification and evaluation of automation components and systems
- Preparing and supporting Factory Acceptance Tests, including coordination with suppliers and alignment within our global automation team
- Providing support for installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities for automation systems at construction sites worldwide, primarily through short-term assignments (remote and on-site, as required)
- Serving as a key technical interface within our global automation organization and other global stakeholders
- Ensuring compliance with internal standards, project-specific requirements, functional safety and IT/OT security guidelines
- Creating and reviewing technical documentation using database-based and engineering IT tools
- Actively sharing knowledge and best practices and mentoring junior engineers
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of our automation solutions
- Contribute to the development, maintenance and evolution of standardized automation solutions
- Drive modularization, reusability and productization of automation assets to support scalable and future-proof solutions

Profil

- Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or comparable technical discipline
- Several years of professional experience in automation engineering for industrial or process plants, preferably in chemical or electrolysis plant engineering
- Strong hands-on experience with industrial automation systems and hardware, including SAS and PLC platforms from leading manufacturers
- Strong understanding of automation system architectures
- Interest or experience in new automation technologies, digitalization, simulation or advanced engineering methods is an advantage
- Solid knowledge of network and fieldbus technologies (e.g. Profinet, Modbus TCP)
- Experience or strong understanding of functional safety and IT/OT security concepts in industrial environments
- Ability to work independently and structured, with a strong sense of ownership for technical results and quality
- Proven capability to work in international and intercultural teams
- Very good English und German communication skills, both written and verbal (min. C1)
- Willingness to travel internationally for short-term assignments
- Natural inclination to coach and support less experienced colleagues, acting as a role model within the team

Das bieten wir

As part of the thyssenkrupp group, we offer our employees high level conditions and many benefits:

- performance-related compensation according to collective agreement Metal und Electro NRW
- attractive old-age provision models
- groupwide learning measures
- thyssenkrupp Group health campaigns and programs
At thyssenkrupp nucera, we attach great importance to individual needs - to this end, we are constantly developing as an employer and offer a wide range of benefits for your perfect working-life-balance:
- In an environment characterized by flat hierarchies and a lot of personal responsibility, we create space for individual development.

The Friedrich Schiller University Jena is a dynamic and innovation-driven university centrally located in Germany. With a broad range of disciplines, it shapes the future through excellent research and teaching. Its scientific excellence is reflected in the profile areas Light - Life - Liberty, which provide pioneering insights and sustainable solutions for the society of tomorrow. Through close collaborations with leading research institutions, innovative companies, and renowned cultural organizations, it advances interdisciplinary developments. With around 17,000 students and approximately 10,000 employees, it defines Jena as a vibrant, internationally connected city of science and innovation.

The Institute of Biodiversity, Ecology and Evolution at the Faculty of Biological Sciences seeks to fill the position of a

Doctoral Researcher in Viral Ecology (m/f/d)

commencing on 01 December 2026. We offer a part-time position (65%, 26 hours per week), with a fixed-term employment until 30 June 2030.

The DFG-funded Collaborative Research Centre 1768 “VirusREvolution: Decoding tools for virus research” is a highly ambitious research centre at Friedrich Schiller University with the joint goal to develop novel tools for virus discovery, characterisation, regulation, interaction, and visualisation (https://virusrevolution.uni-jena.de/). Its integrated research training group is educating doctoral researchers in a structured, interdisciplinary training program and invites applications for doctoral and postdoctoral researcher positions in various fields of research.
In this doctoral project “Do viruses exploit their quasispecies for host range evolution?”, you will investigate how host range and environmental conditions shape virus diversity and virus-host interactions in natural and experimentally manipulated microbial communities.
Conduct experimental work and analyses on virus-host interactions in soil and groundwater ecosystems, including host-range assays, environmental sampling, and targeted microcosm experiments
Analyse metagenomic and viromic data sets from soil and groundwater samples to identify broad- and narrow-host-range viruses to characterize their quasispecies characteristics
Participation in the Collaborative Research Centre VirusREvolution and close collaboration with the tandem project partner
Engage in regular discussions with other group and project members
Collaborate with BSc and MSc students working in associated projects
Publish papers and present your work at national and international scientific meetings

A highly motivated candidate with a Master of Science or equivalent degree in biology, microbiology, microbial ecology, virology, bioinformatics, or a related discipline
Experience in experimental microbiology, microbial ecology, and molecular biological methods; knowledge of sequencing-based bioinformatic approaches (metagenomics, viromics); experience with virus-host interactions are desirable.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving
Ability to work independently and in a collaborative team
Excellent skills in English are required, both written and spoken

Embedding in a cross-disciplinary, experienced research group and a large, ambitious research consortium
Affiliation to an Integrated Research Training Group, offering close support and a comprehensive education program for hard skills and transferable skills, supported by the Jena Graduate Academy
A family-friendly working environment with a variety of offers for families
University health promotion and a wide range of university sports activities
Remuneration based on the provisions of the Collective Agreement for the Public Sector of the Federal States (TV-L) up to salary scale E13 - depending on the candidate’s personal qualifications -, including a special annual payment in accordance with the collective agreement.
30 days of vacation per calendar year plus two days off on December 24 and 31

jobs.description:
Introduction

The INM-Leibniz Institute for New Materials is an internationally leading center for interdisciplinary research on materials, and their exploitation in materials-based solutions for a sustainable world with increasing digitalization and medical needs. Our research integrates materials chemistry, biological engineering, physical analysis, process engineering and data science. We collaborate with academic and industrial partners all around the world.

A focus of our research are Engineered Living Materials (ELMs), an emergent class of materials from the combination of inert materials and living organism, with huge potential for sustainable innovation in different technological fields. Across the institute, materials scientists, synthetic biologists and biophysicists cooperate to understand living and inert matter, and to realize new materials with unprecedented functions from a synergistic interfacing.

We are strongly linked to collaborative initiatives in the ELM field including the Leibniz ScienceCampus LifeMat, Living Therapeutic Materials, the Priority Program SPP2451 “Living Materials with Adaptive Functions”, and the MaterialVital Hub.

As part of our ELM research community, we are seeking a

Postdoctoral Researcher with expertise in Microbial Biophysics (f/m/d)

with interest in the fundamental understanding of microbial communities within synthetic microenvironments. The candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary research team within the Department Dynamic Biomaterials at INM.

Experimental research to understand microbial behaviour in confined spaces (synthetic hydrogels) and dynamic environments using imaging, microfluidics and molecular biology methods.
Scientific cooperation with researchers in materials science and synthetic biology at INM, and with external partners in bioanalytics/bioinformatics within running funded projects.
Compilation and presentation of research results in the form of progress reports and presentations at project meetings and scientific conferences.
Communication of research results within the scientific community at conferences and scientific events, and publication in scientific journals.
Co-supervision of students and doctoral researchers.
Support and promote the digitalization of ELM research in collaboration with dedicated experts in the group.

PhD degree in biophysics/cell biology or related discipline.
Experience during your PhD or previous postdoctoral stay as experimental researcher in the field of microbial biophysics.
Interest in collaborative and interdisciplinary research challenges.
Self-driven and hands-on personality. Organization and prioritization skills.
Very good communication skills in English.

Work in an emergent research topic, with multiple opportunities to develop a competitive research profile.
An interdisciplinary research environment with complementary expertise and ready to share knowledge and support your work.
State-of-the-art infrastructure, including access to Core Facilities run by experts.
Access to a broad international network with vibrant scientific collaborators and exciting cooperation projects.
A highly professional and supportive working environment with an open and international culture.
A well-structured on-boarding process and clear responsibilities.
Transparent opportunities for career development.
Flexible working hours and mobile working opportunity.
A family-friendly working place.
A EG 13 TV-L position (full time). A part time position is also possible.

The position is initially for 2 years.
